note: The gap register turns the 18-bot ledger into a build order. A row names the capability, the rows in features.json it would change, the competitor that proves demand, and the smallest next step. It is research, not a promise: phase values follow Roadmap v3 and may move.

gaps.title: Restore roles after a member leaves
gaps.nextStep: Live-prove one real leave and rejoin with role persistence on; the adapter path is tested.
gaps.note: Shipped in pass 71: an opt-in snapshot on leave and a one-shot restore on rejoin, capped and with Discord as the final authority. Carl-bot sells levels and voice-role links; neither is the same promise.

gaps.title: Portable case export
gaps.nextStep: Live-prove one real download through the Discord adapter and read the attachment back; the service and command paths are tested.
gaps.note: Shipped in pass 72: `/mod case` and `/mod history` accept `format:json|csv` and attach the existing case and event rows with a content checksum. No surveyed generalist documents a complete case export.

gaps.title: Event buttons, reminders and ICS
gaps.nextStep: Live-prove one signed button press and one downloaded `.ics` in a real calendar; the router path and the serializer are adapter-tested only.
gaps.note: Shipped in pass 73: opening an event posts signed Going/Not going buttons that call the same rsvp service, the existing 60-second tick sends one claimed reminder, and `/event export` adds an ICS built from the same payload. Per-member timezones and a real calendar consumer remain open.

gaps.title: Forms travel in the guild bundle
gaps.nextStep: Live-prove one export and restore on Postgres with a real form file; the PGlite round trip reads the rows back through the forms adapter.
gaps.note: Shipped in pass 74: bundle v2 carries a form definition and every response with preserved ids, the existing checksum covers them, and an older bundle is refused rather than read as a guild with no forms.

gaps.title: Searchable ticket knowledge base
gaps.nextStep: Store guild-scoped articles, retrieve exact matches first, and answer only with a citation; no match hands off with no model call.
gaps.note: This is the support depth that keeps Ticket Tool installed. The difference is integration with the ticket row and zero retention.

gaps.title: Captcha and alt-account signals
gaps.nextStep: Add a local challenge behind the existing join gate and an optional provider port; add local account-age, avatar and invite heuristics with no IP by default.
gaps.note: Double Counter's data network cannot be copied honestly. The local signals and a provider port can, with a clear privacy note.

gaps.title: Structure snapshot and restore
gaps.nextStep: Export roles, channels, categories and permission overwrites as a diffable bundle, then restore into a clean guild with a dry-run first.
gaps.note: The data bundle restores rows; it does not rebuild server structure. Wick proves admins pay for this.

gaps.title: One member timeline
gaps.nextStep: Build one read model that joins cases, tickets, invites, XP, economy, forms, events, modmail and logs by guild and member; every row names its source table.
gaps.note: No surveyed generalist has it. This is the feature that turns a bundle of modules into a product.

gaps.title: Voice XP
gaps.nextStep: Award XP from voice-state minutes with an anti-idle check, a minimum channel size and a per-member cap; reuse the XP projection.
gaps.note: Message and reaction XP ship. Arcane paywalls voice XP and Lurkr does not document it, so a free voice path is a real difference.

gaps.title: Generated rank card image
gaps.nextStep: Render a local PNG with the member name, level, rank and progress bar; keep the V2 panel as the fallback and never call a hosted image service.
gaps.note: The V2 card ships and is readable; the visual bar set by MEE6 is an image. The local render is the missing piece.

gaps.title: Welcome image card
gaps.nextStep: Render a local welcome PNG with the avatar, name and member count, behind a setting; keep the V2 text as the default and the fallback.
gaps.note: ProBot's welcome image is its clearest retention feature. A local render has no external dependency.

gaps.title: YouTube, Twitch and Kick feeds
gaps.nextStep: Add source adapters behind one feed port, keep GUID dedupe, add per-source backoff and a delivery scheduler that survives restart.
gaps.note: RSS is stored, parsed, deduped and delivered on an event. The missing sources and scheduler are the specialist gap.

gaps.title: Real music playback
gaps.nextStep: A human listener joins the channel and hears the node, then a real client clicks one card button; both proofs are needed before this row can be covered.
gaps.note: Playback ships behind an operator-owned Lavalink node and every queue control is live-proven through the dashboard. `playingPlayers:1` proves frames were sent; no person has heard them, and the MCP server cannot click a card button, so the audible and interaction proofs stay open.

gaps.title: Ticket ratings and SLA view
gaps.nextStep: Ask for one rating when a ticket closes, store it on the ticket, and print first-response and resolution times from the existing events.
gaps.note: SLA counters exist. Ticket Tool sells CSAT reports on Pro; a rating row plus the existing transcript is the missing half.

gaps.title: Canned staff replies
gaps.nextStep: Store guild-scoped snippets with a short key, offer autocomplete to staff, and audit each use without storing message content.
gaps.note: Ticket Tool's /canned is free on every plan, so this is table stakes rather than a differentiator.

gaps.title: Search archived transcripts
gaps.nextStep: Index the archived transcript rows with a bounded full-text query, respect retention, and return links rather than dumping content.
gaps.note: Transcripts are archived and downloadable; they are not searchable. Ticket Tool makes transcript search a dashboard feature.

gaps.title: Statroles from member activity
gaps.nextStep: Grant or remove a role from a bounded activity condition on a scheduled reconciliation, with a dry run and an audit row.
gaps.note: Stat channels update a name; Statbot turns the same statistics into roles. The role rule is the missing capability.

gaps.title: Jobs, custom income and item actions
gaps.nextStep: Add cooldown-based jobs and custom income commands that write the existing ledger, plus item actions with an explicit idempotency key.
gaps.note: The ledger, shop and inventory ship. UnbelievaBoat's depth is income sources and item actions, not a second currency.

gaps.title: AI setup planner with approval
gaps.nextStep: Ask a provider for a schema-validated settings patch, preview the exact diff with the audit helper, bind apply to its fingerprint, and refuse a stale plan.
gaps.note: The AI-native entrants sell setup speed. Keystone can match it only with a preview and an approval gate; AI may propose, never write.

gaps.title: One help hub that knows this server
gaps.nextStep: Live-prove one module pick and one Overview press through a human client; the signed routes and panel trees are adapter-tested only.
gaps.note: Shipped in pass 75: `/help` reads the modules, tickets, cases, health and registry the bot already owns and renders them as a V2 hub with signed controls. The surveyed generalists ship a command list and a separate dashboard; the hub is the in-Discord bridge between them.
